author: Immachi
message: Every day you make our home brighter, Aysha. We are so proud of the kind, brave girl you are becoming.

author: Ippachi
message: Keep showing up with that focus of yours, champ. Your orange belt did not happen by luck; it happened because you worked for it.

author: Neenu
message: You are my favorite person to laugh with. Love you to the moon and back, sis.

author: Kuttimon
message: Whenever I see you train, I think: little warrior, big heart. Keep making us proud.

author: Nasri
message: You have this glow that makes everyone around you smile. Never stop being exactly you.

author: Shani
message: Discipline looks good on you, Aysha. Cheering for every kick, every bow, and every brave try.

author: Shebi
message: Birthday hugs! Save room for cake and save some energy for whatever fun thing you pick next.

author: Aydi
message: The award still goes to you. Cannot wait for our next silly adventure together.

author: Niju
message: You inspire me more than you know. Go get whatever dream you are chasing this year.

author: Izu
message: Team Aysha forever! You are the coolest and we are lucky to have you.
